_comment: Brand names are null throughout: the page writes generics with illustrative examples in parentheses (e.g. Udiliv, Ursocol), which is not the brand dispensed. THE headline trap (traps.md Y1). Paracetamol is prescribed while the same page advises avoiding liver-toxic medications 'e.g. alcohol, acetaminophen'. Both must be extracted faithfully; the contradiction is found later, and suppressing either side destroys the finding. Date '01/11/2025' is ambiguous (DD/MM vs MM/DD, both parts <= 12) so it is null per PRD 11.3. The investigations are SUGGESTED tests with no values, so labResults is empty.

medications.sourceText: Ursodeoxycholic 300 mg (e.g. Udiliv, Ursocol) 1 tab PO Twice daily 2-4 weeks
Vitamin B Complex (e.g. Becosules) 1 tab PO Once daily 2-4 weeks
Silymarin 140 mg (e.g. Silybon, Hepamerz) 1 tab PO Twice daily 2-4 weeks
Pantoprazole 40 mg (e.g. Pantocid, Pensec) 1 tab PO Once daily 2-4 weeks
Paracetamol 500mg (e.g. Crocin) 1 tab PO Only if fever > 101F Every 6 hours As needed
